check_rule1_desc: Demands for ₹200 to ₹2500 in processing fees, form checks, or tractor delivery charges are 100% fraud.
check_rule2_desc: No government officer or scheme agent will ever call and ask for your bank OTP or UPI PIN.
check_rule3_desc: Messages claiming free brand-new cars, lottery jackpots, or ₹50,000 cash for filling a survey are fake.
check_rule4_desc: Genuine government web portals ALWAYS end in .gov.in or .nic.in. Domains ending in .xyz, .top, .free, or .blogspot are fraudulent.
